assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit target is the supplied low-poly floating male head asset. Preserve his exact recognizable facial features, angular mesh silhouette, pose, hair shape, thick eyebrows, small moustache and chin beard, face proportions, eye placement and closed mouth. Change ONLY the color treatment and surface texture. Make this a truly strange late-1990s psychedelic nightmare game head: skin largely electric magenta and bruised violet, acid yellow-green across the forehead, nose plane and some cheek planes; hair charcoal purple with isolated sickly green grain; eyes remain readable dark holes with tiny off-white glints. The color patches follow the coarse angular face planes rather than decorative stripes. Add strong analog dirty grain and coarse ordered 2-4 pixel dithering visibly embedded across the whole face texture; damaged 64px indexed-color photographic texture mapped over the angular low-poly model, conspicuous noisy pixels, gritty VHS still feel. NO smooth beauty finish, no photographic natural skin colors, no blur, no neon glow or bloom. Keep exact identity and head-only design; do not put random typography, symbols, pupils, additional anatomy, body, neck, or backgrounds. SINGLE floating head, centered on genuinely transparent background, all hair and chin inside frame with generous 8% empty margin. Standalone PNG game sprite, no text or frame.
